concerns.text: FR-001 (Download ALL spectra) and US-1 Independent Test (count 30-45) lack a specific task to enforce the 'ALL available' download policy without pre-filtering. Task T011c defines classification logic (radius cutoffs) that risks filtering the dataset before the 'ALL' download is complete. Task T015a exists but is ambiguous on whether it applies the T011c filters. A dedicated task ensuring the raw API fetch ignores all derived categories is missing.

FR-003 mandates 'Kendall's tau' for censored data. The plan and spec mention 'Akritas-Theil-Sen' as the method, but no task explicitly implements the Akritas-Theil-Sen estimator or maps it to the FR-003 requirement. Task T025b implements 'scikit-survival's kendall_tau', which may not be the correct censored estimator if the spec/plan intended Akritas-Theil-Sen. The specific algorithm required by the plan (ATS) is not explicitly tagged or described in a task.

FR-005 requires a 'Tobit regression model (or equivalent censored-data model)'. The plan specifies a 'Ridge Regression Fallback' for collinearity. Task T027 implements a fallback to 'Survival Regression (Cox PH or AFT)' instead of Ridge. There is no task implementing the 'Ridge Regression Fallback' explicitly required by the plan's Complexity Tracking table, creating a gap between the plan's approved method and the task list.

SC-003 requires measuring the robustness of the *correlation* (CI width of tau). Task T026 calculates the CI width of the *water mixing ratio distribution* using Kaplan-Meier. There is no task that explicitly calculates the CI width of the Kendall's tau coefficient (or ATS equivalent) to satisfy SC-003. The current task validates the wrong metric.

SC-004 requires statistical power ≥ 0.8 for detecting a *moderate correlation (|tau| ≥ 0.3)*. Task T031 describes a 'post-hoc power analysis' based on 'actual achieved sample size' but does not explicitly anchor the test to the |tau| ≥ 0.3 effect size threshold required by SC-004. The task description is insufficient to guarantee the success criterion is met.

Tasks T035, T045-T049 implement 'Review Response' logic (Methane Interference, Spectral Resolution Reporting, etc.) that is not explicitly mapped to any FR or SC in the spec. While these address reviewer concerns, they appear as scope creep without a corresponding requirement tag (e.g., [FR-XXX] or [SC-XXX]) or a clear link to a specific plan element, making traceability incomplete.
